query.description: The data format. Value can be xml or json.
The starting record returned. 0 is the first record.
The number of records returned. The maximum limit is 250.
The year the issue was published. For example, the value can be 2022.
The month the issue was published. For example, the value can be 6.
The day the issue was published. For example, the value can be 28.

description.content: Congress.gov shares its application programming interface (API) with the public to ingest the Congressional data. Sign up for an API key from api.data.gov that you can use to access web services provided by Congress.gov. To learn more, view our GitHub repository.
